description: This file implements the connection bridging between Chromium DevTools Protocol (CDP) and Browser BiDi protocol, including classes for transport and connection management, and a function to establish a BiDi over CDP connection.

classes.name: BidiTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the BidiTransport interface, managing message handling and connection reference.

classes.name: BidiConnection
classes.description: Represents a connection transport, managing message sending and lifecycle events.

classes.name: CdpTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the bidiTransport.Transport interface, bridging messages between CDP connection and BiDi protocol.

methods.name: connectBidiOverCdp
methods.description: Establishes a BiDi connection over a given CDP transport, setting up server, transport, and connection objects.

methods.name: setOnMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for BidiTransportImpl.
